metadata.name: Journey Tension Assessment
metadata.description: 3+1 diagnostic questions mapping to journey levels

questions.question: When it comes to knowing how you want to show up in the world...

options.label: I have no idea. I don't know what change I want to make or how I fit
I have a sense of what I care about but I can't articulate it yet
I can describe it but I'm still testing whether it's really me
I know exactly how I want to show up and the change I want to make

questions.question: When it comes to letting people see where you're really at...

options.label: I keep it to myself. Letting people in feels unsafe
I open up occasionally but only when it feels controlled
I can be honest with a few people, but I still filter the messy parts
I let people see all of it. The uncertainty, the struggle, the real me

questions.question: When it comes to taking action on what matters...

options.label: I'm stuck. Fear of judgement and not being good enough keeps me frozen
I start things but fear of what people think stops me finishing
I take action, but I still hold back the bold stuff to stay safe
I move. The fear is there but it doesn't decide for me anymore

questions.question: When it comes to investing in the path you're on...

options.label: I don't feel safe putting real skin in the game
I invest a little but I always keep one foot in the safe option
I'm committing more, but the big bet still terrifies me
I feel safe going all in. The risk feels right because the path is mine
